status: protocol: frozen before any rollout from its starts; the code lands in its own PR with a smoke
evidence: exploratory: the failure definition was chosen after #62's development rollouts were seen

members.normalizer: both checkpoints' preprocessor and postprocessor stats are byte-identical (asserted), so actions compare in one normalized space
members.precision: LeRobot default: TF32 cuDNN convolutions, strict FP32 matmuls (#62 amendment)
members.reproducibility: bitwise within siddh's pinned environment, not across hardware

environment.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition

stage_b_evaluation.read: not before Stage B's arms are frozen

starts.not_used_for_evaluation: 1000-1099: inspected repeatedly; they motivated this study

discovery.driver: tools/pusht_recovery/stage_b2.py's Policy, as lerobot-eval drives it; no probe
discovery.episode: env.reset(seed=start); to success or 300 steps; scored up to the first success
discovery.seeding: the 4 repeats run in lockstep as one batch; torch seeded with SeedSequence([66, base, start, chunk]) before each chunk; batch row r is repeat r
discovery.lockstep: each row's episode is recorded up to its own end; the batch steps until all four rows end, and every row's inputs are saved so any chunk regenerates
discovery.saved: every step's observation, full simulator state, action and coverage (1e-9); every chunk's seed

consequential_failure.why: B1's competence line: half the hold-still (0.062) to demonstration-replay (0.946) gap

discovery.failure_start: at least 3 of the base's 4 repeats fail consequentially
discovery.units: the consequentially failing rollouts of failure starts
discovery.near_miss: no success and max coverage >= 0.504: descriptive only

reach.state: 18 points: agent and 8 T keypoints, previous and current frame
reach.support: the 5,040 states of the r = 0.25 subset's 41 demonstrations (subset seed 0)
reach.tau_rule: the 99th percentile of one demonstration step plus the largest replay error (support.json)
reach.departure: t_e: the first t >= 1 with d_sup(x_{t-1}) <= tau and d_sup(x_t) > tau
reach.matched_row: j*: the support state nearest x_{t_e - 1}; j* + 8 must be a row of its episode
reach.descriptive: the same classes and d_sup quantiles for successful and near-miss rollouts

recovery.indexing: LeRobot 0.6.1 Diffusion Policy: slot k is the action at time t_e + k - 1; slots 1-8 are executed from the observation
recovery.slot_0: the action that produced x_{t_e}: history, masked from the loss, never a target
recovery.slots_1_8: the first 8 actions applied from x_{t_e}: Gauss-Newton with minimum-norm steps over the 16 values, from the demonstrated actions of rows j* .. j* + 7, from the saved full state at t_e; residual: the chain's agent position and T pose after slot 8 against row j* + 8
recovery.slots_9_15: the demonstrated actions of rows j* + 8 onward
recovery.mask: slot 0 masked; slots 1-8 supervised; slot k >= 9 supervised while every chain state from slot 9 on is within 1.0 px of its row and the row exists (a prefix)
recovery.checks: Stage A's: action bounds [0, 512], every chain state finite, the speed envelope, the penetration and extent envelope, provenance, an independent rebuild audit and a byte-identical rerun
recovery.per_rollout: one window, at the departure; a rejected window is never replaced

decision.pass: at least 100 valid windows from at least 20 distinct failure starts (#52's B3 yield)
decision.stage: passes only if both bases pass; otherwise it stops, is published, and the study ends
decision.no_search: no threshold, horizon, window or tau is changed after outcomes

audit: fresh process per base: chunks regenerate bit for bit; coverage within 1e-9; labels, failure starts, d_sup, departures, matched rows and classes identical; accepted windows rebuilt independently and rejections reproduce with their reason; simulator replay a measurement, not a gate (#53)

checks: faults refused: changed action, flipped label, moved departure step, forged recovery chunk

compute.host: siddh, one base per GPU, unpaid
compute.estimate: about 200 starts x 30 chunks x 0.36 s per batch of 4: about 0.6 GPU-h per base for discovery, as long again for its audit; A2 and A3 on the CPU
compute.gate: the code PR's smoke measures the cost; the run starts only if its projection is within the ceiling

stage_b: only if Stage A passes on both bases, under its own protocol PR: #52's B4 comparison (base, self-distillation, oracle recovery; slot 0 masked in both fine-tuned arms), evaluated on starts 6000-6099
